Zidane faces Italy again as France coach 20 years after headbutt

Zinedine Zidane, the former French football player, is set to face Italy again, this time as the coach of the French national team. The encounter occurs twenty years after his infamous headbutt incident during a World Cup final match. One commentator, Dhorasoo, expressed excitement about Zidane's coaching, anticipating France's success under his leadership.
